headline: Lithium Miners Rise 1.21% from Lows Amid 2027 Glut Concerns
summary: Lithium miners gained 1.21% following a one-year low, though they remain 33.5% below their May peak as oversupply fears weigh on producers like Albemarle and SQM.
why: Lithium equities remain highly sensitive to supply-demand forecasts for electric vehicle battery raw materials and long-term commodity price trends.

entities.name: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile

impacts.name: Lithium Miners
impacts.why: Lithium mining stocks rose 1.21% off their recent lows despite broader glut concerns.
